algorithm_steps: Extract the source incidence/constraint interface and define an exact signature for each live component.
Merge only components with byte-identical exact signatures under all exposed source operations.
Build the quotient interaction graph without semantic-oracle equivalence tests.
Reject the candidate immediately if quotient width or signature count is not polynomially bounded.
Compile each quotient node and interface transition into the target circuit representation.
Reconstruct a source witness by replaying stored exact quotient maps and verify it against the original instance.
candidate.anti_loop_rationale: Operator family EXACT_INTERFACE_QUOTIENT must be compared against existing Keymaster barriers and prior fingerprints; a renamed known route or a route requiring a hidden SAT/semantic-equivalence oracle is rejected.

complexity_plan.construction: Require an explicit polynomial bound on decomposition/quotient construction before admission.
complexity_plan.reconstruction: Store provenance maps at every reduction and require polynomial backward replay.
complexity_plan.state: Require a polynomial bound on all stored signatures/tables and a fixed bound on target width.
complexity_plan.verification: Verify the reconstructed source witness/certificate directly in polynomial time.

falsification_tests.test: Search bounded Tseitin families for superpolynomially many exact quotient signatures.
Search for a pair merged by the proposed signature that separates after one legal source operation.
Measure target treewidth on adversarial expander-derived instances and reject on unbounded growth.
